title: Generative AI Engineer
description_preview:
We are seeking an innovative and highly motivated Generative AI Engineer to join our growing AI team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and cloud technologies. 
 



 The candidate will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build intelligent AI solutions including AI assistants, automation systems, enterprise AI workflows, recommendation engines, and AI\-powered chatbots. 
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 


* Design, develop, and deploy scalable Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build AI\-powered chatbots, AI agents, virtual assistants, and workflow automation systems.
* Integrate AI models with enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and databases.
* Develop and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector database architectures.
* Work with advanced AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and OpenAI APIs.
* Fine\-tune and evaluate foundation models including GPT, Llama, Claude, Gemini, and open\-source LLMs.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies to improve AI response quality and system performance.
* Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver AI\-driven solutions.
* Implement secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI architectures.
* Monitor model performance and continuously improve AI systems using evaluation metrics and feedback loops.
* Ensure compliance with responsible AI practices, security standards, and data privacy regulations.
* Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, trends, and best practices.



**Required Qualifications** 
  
 


* Master's Degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP concepts.
* Experience with APIs, cloud platforms, and backend integrations.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.



**Nice to Have** 
  
 


* 0–2 years of experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, or software development.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of MLOps and AI deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with vector databases and AI agents.
* Experience working with enterprise AI applications.



**Technical Skills** 
  
 


* Python • Generative AI • Large Language Models (LLMs) • LangChain • Hugging Face • OpenAI API • Prompt Engineering • TensorFlow / PyTorch • NLP • Vector Databases • Docker • Git/GitHub • AWS / Azure / GCP

title: Junior Engineer, AI
description_preview:
1\. About Our Client:
 



 Established in 2004, the organization is a Massachusetts\-based consulting firm focused on designing, implementing, and evaluating public health programs for government partners at local, regional, and state levels. It supports evidence\-based, community\-driven solutions aimed at strengthening public health systems and advancing equity. The organization often works as an extension of its clients'' staff through multi\-year, multi\-project engagements.
 



  





 2\. About the Opportunity:
 



 The Junior Engineer, AI role involves designing and building AI\-powered tools to enhance public health capabilities. Reporting to the AI Committee Lead, this hands\-on position develops practical AI solutions that improve operational efficiency and client service by leveraging emerging AI technologies across multiple cloud platforms.
 



  





 3\. Responsibilities:
 



 • Build and deploy AI applications and automation tools on platforms including Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, and Anthropic/OpenAI APIs.
 



 • Design and develop client\-facing AI applications, such as chatbots, supporting public health programs and government operations.
 



 • Create tools for data collection, aggregation, and analysis to replace manual processes with automation.
 



 • Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for intelligent internal tools.
 



 • Integrate large language models, AI agents, and new frameworks to address operational and public health challenges.
 



 • Develop lightweight internal apps and dashboards using AppScript or similar tools.
 



 • Collaborate with the AI Committee Lead to translate public health needs into technical AI solutions.
 



 • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Work with teams to identify and prioritize impactful AI opportunities.
 



 • Present updates and recommendations to leadership and project teams.
 



 • Research new AI models and platforms to select appropriate tools.
 



 • Establish testing and quality assurance processes to ensure AI system reliability.
 



 • Monitor and optimize AI model performance, cost, and reliability.
 



 • Maintain documentation and best practices for AI tools.
 



  





 4\. Requirements:
 



 • Bachelor''s degree and at least one year of relevant experience; recent graduates encouraged to apply.
 



 • Experience (internship, coursework, or professional) in AI/ML application development or related software engineering.
 



 • Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages.
 



 • Experience designing and implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
 



 • Familiarity with vector databases and cloud\-native vector search solutions.
 



 • Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Gemini.
 



 • Knowledge of Google AppScript or similar automation tools.
 



 • Experience testing LLM outputs for accuracy and reliability.
 



 • Strong communication skills for non\-technical audiences.
 



 • Ability to work independently and in a team within a remote consulting environment.
 



 • Alignment with the organization’s shared values.
 



  





 Preferred:
 



 • Experience with frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.
 



 • Knowledge of MLOps tools and practices (e.g., Docker).
 



 • Ability to write production\-level SQL and use data warehousing solutions (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake).
 



 • Experience with data privacy tools such as Google DLP.
 



 • Interest or experience in public health, healthcare, or government sectors.
 



 • Experience connecting public health and technology projects.
 



 • Optimistic, solution\-focused mindset.
 



 • Ability to concisely summarize technical ideas.
 



  





 5\. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
 



 • Salary range: $70,720 \- $83,200 annually.
 



 • Compensation includes paid leave totaling over six weeks, health, dental, and vision insurance with substantial employer coverage, health and dependent care FSAs, 401(k) plan with employer match, employer\-paid disability insurance, a technology stipend, and professional development opportunities.
 



  





 6\. Benefits \& Perks:
 



 • Health, dental, and vision insurance with partial employer coverage.
 



 • Paid vacation, sick time, personal leave, and floating holidays totaling over six weeks.
 



 • Health and dependent care flexible spending accounts.
 



 • 401(k) plan with employer match.
 



 • Employer\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance.
 



 • Technology stipend.
 



 • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
 



  





 Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
 



  





 Note:
 



 RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

 xAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
 

 Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
 

 We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
 

 All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

* You will work on the most critical modeling challenges at any given time.
* You will get clarity on your first project before an offer.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** 
* You believe truth\-seeking AI is the most important and challenging problem.
* You are obsessed about building incredibly useful models.
* You are a power user of AI models.
* If you previously trained models used by millions of people it’s a big plus, but modeling experience is not required.
* You take pride in your work and thrive in meritocratic environments.

 $180,000 \- $600,000 USD
 



 Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
